triples.head_surface: failure of the lubricating oil system
triples.evidence_text: Audible and visual alarms are to be fitted for each lubricating oil system of engine, turbine or gear to warn of the failure of the lubricating oil system

triples.head_surface: failure of the lubricating oil supply to the gas turbine or the associated gear
triples.head_canonical_zh: 燃气轮机或关联齿轮滑油供应失效
triples.tail_surface: automatic quick acting device to shut off the fuel supply
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 自动快速切断燃油装置
triples.evidence_text: Propulsion gas turbines are to be fitted with an automatic quick acting device to shut off the fuel supply upon failure of the lubricating oil supply to the gas turbine or the associated gear

triples.head_surface: failure of the lubricating oil supply to the reduction gear
triples.head_canonical_zh: 减速齿轮滑油供应失效
triples.tail_surface: automatic means ... to stop the engines
triples.evidence_text: an automatic means is to be fitted to stop the engines in the event of failure of the lubricating oil supply to the reduction gear
